issues.detail: The Hebrew 'עֹרֹת תְּחָשִׁים' refers to 'skins of tachash' (a specific animal, often translated as dolphin, porpoise, or badger), not 'da thú mầu tía' (purple-colored animal skin). The color 'tía' (purple) is not in the Hebrew text; the Hebrew only specifies the type of animal skin, not its color.
